steps.note: Open the prepared closed two-bid event directly in Master QCS.
Enable split awarding required for the closest available allocation test.
Enable eRFX project behavior required by the case.
Open the awarding screen where vendor quantities can be allocated.
Allocate four units to the second prepared vendor, corresponding to the requested B allocation.
Allocate the remaining six units to the first prepared vendor so the available two-vendor award covers all ten units.
Assert that the closest supported two-vendor split selects the full line and both vendors, with 4 × 90 plus 6 × 100 totaling 960.
Create the award proposal from the completed closest-supported allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal without adding an approval step.
Assert that the award proposal was submitted.
